s.note: opening night at Smoke and Stack's place
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, a pinch of sugar, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk and rest 10 minutes. Spoon into 175C oil and fry until golden. Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp hot sauce to dip.

s.note: Annie keeps garlic close, and she knows why
s.how: Roast a head of garlic in foil at 180C for 40 minutes. Squeeze into 100g soft butter with parsley and salt and mash. Spread on 8 thick slices of white bread and toast at 200C until crisp at the edges.

m.note: a plate to keep Delta Slim playing all night
m.how: Season, flour and brown 4 thick pork chops. Make a dark roux with 40g butter and 3 tbsp flour, add 2 sliced onions, then 500ml stock and thyme. Simmer the chops in the gravy for 40 minutes. Serve over 300g long grain rice.

w.note: something sweet to close out the night
w.how: Roast 800g sweet potatoes until soft, peel and mash with 60g butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, nutmeg and vanilla. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes.

d.note: the twins come home from Chicago with stock
d.how: Tilt each glass and pour the stout three-quarters full, let it settle for a minute, then top up slowly for a tight head. Allow 2 cans or bottles per person.
